items.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: if I’m trying to get into one of Bird’s things I would be inclined to try and match his tone, the sound of his horn, as opposed to using a syllable

ctx.x: If you were doing a Charlie Parker solo and then you were trying to do a Miles solo, would you choose different syllables to pull that solo off?

Good question. I’m inclined to go with the sound okay, as opposed to syllable. For instance if [scats] if I’m trying to get into one of Bird’s things I would be inclined to try and match his tone, the sound of his horn, as opposed to using a syllable. And with the horn it’s [scats] that kind of thing. I’m more inclined towards that, which I discovered what maybe a couple of years ago. Because I didn’t realize how much those guys were influencing me. Are you following what I’m saying?
